title: Does Including CoT in Monitor Context Improve Calibration as Well as AUROC?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: If CoT improves AUROC but degrades calibration, deployers relying on confidence thresholds would be misled. This nuance is absent from current literature and directly affects threshold-setting for interventions.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Two conditions (CoT-visible vs CoT-hidden), collecting confidence scores, computing ECE. API-based, no model training. ECE computation is straightforward. Accessible for CS students.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two conditions, one dataset, two metrics (AUROC and ECE). Reliability diagram as deliverable. Minimal setup. Easily within 30 hours.
